title: 017 - Safe Division
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print 0 when the divisor is zero instead of crashing and prints exactly `0`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function safeDivision(array $values): int
{
    return array_sum(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value % 2 === 1));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function safeDivision(array $values): int
{
    return array_sum(array_filter($values, fn($value) => $value % 2 === 0));
}
hint: Guard the division before it happens.
explanation: The broken code divides by zero. Adding the zero check first returns the safe fallback output.
